content: Two batch of tests were performed. The first on the $D$ set of documents common to the two subcorpus “specialist” $E$ and “naive” $N$ from Annodis. $D$ contains 38 documents with 13 364 words. This first test allowed to measure the distance between the human markers. In fact, in order to get an idea of the quality of the human segmentations, the cuts in the texts made by the specialists were measured it versus the so-called “naifs” note takers and vice versa. The second series of tests consisted of using all the documents of the subcorpus “specialist” $E$, because the documents of the subcorpus of Annodis are not identical. Then we benchmarked the performance of the three systems automatically.
